description_en: Creates a QoS rule for Express Connect
description_zh: 调用CreateExpressConnectTrafficQosRule接口创建高速通道QoS规则
kebab_example: aliyun vpc create-express-connect-traffic-qos-rule --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --qos-id qos-2giu0a6vd5x0mv0000 --queue-id qos-queue-9nyx2u7n71s2rc0000 --priority 1 --protocol ALL --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateExpressConnectTrafficQosRule

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the QoS policy.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
QoS策略所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The priority of the QoS rule. Valid values: 1 to 9000. A larger value indicates a higher priority. The priority must be unique within the same QoS policy
parameters.help_zh: QoS规则优先级。取值范围：1~9000，数字越大优先级越高，在同一个QoS策略内QoS规则优先级不允许重复
parameters.name: priority

parameters.help_en:
The protocol type of the QoS rule. Valid values:

ALL

ICMP(IPv4)

ICMPv6(IPv6)

TCP

UDP

GRE

SSH

Telnet

HTTP

HTTPS

MS SQL

Oracle

MySql

RDP

PostgreSQL

Redis
parameters.help_zh:
QoS规则协议类型，取值：

ALL

ICMP(IPv4)

ICMPv6(IPv6)

TCP

UDP

GRE

SSH

Telnet

HTTP

HTTPS

MS SQL

Oracle

MySql

RDP

PostgreSQL

Redis
parameters.name: protocol

parameters.help_en:
The source IPv4 CIDR block for traffic matching in the QoS rule.

You cannot specify this parameter together with SrcIPv6Cidr or DstIPv6Cidr
parameters.help_zh:
QoS规则流量匹配源IPv4网段。

不支持输入本参数时，再输入参数SrcIPv6Cidr或DstIPv6Cidr
parameters.name: src_cidr

parameters.help_en:
The destination IP address IPv4 CIDR block for traffic matching in the QoS rule.

You cannot specify this parameter together with SrcIPv6Cidr or DstIPv6Cidr
parameters.help_zh:
QoS规则流量匹配目的IPv4网段。

不支持输入本参数时，再输入参数SrcIPv6Cidr或DstIPv6Cidr
parameters.name: dst_cidr

parameters.help_en:
The source IPv6 CIDR block for traffic matching in the QoS rule.

You cannot specify this parameter together with SrcCidr or DstCidr
parameters.help_zh:
QoS规则流量匹配源IPv6网段。

不支持输入本参数时，再输入参数SrcCidr或DstCidr
parameters.name: src_ipv6_cidr

parameters.help_en:
The destination IP address IPv6 CIDR block for traffic matching in the QoS rule.

You cannot specify this parameter together with SrcCidr or DstCidr
parameters.help_zh:
QoS规则流量匹配目的IPv6网段。

不支持输入本参数时，再输入参数SrcCidr或DstCidr
parameters.name: dst_ipv6_cidr

parameters.help_en: The source port range for traffic matching in the QoS rule. Valid values: 0 to 65535. Set the value to -1 if no matching is required. Currently, only a single port number can be specified. The start and end port numbers must be the same
parameters.help_zh: QoS规则流量匹配源端口号范围，取值范围：0~65535，当不匹配时取值为-1。当前只支持指定单个端口号，端口号的起始和终止需要相同
parameters.name: src_port_range

parameters.help_en:
The destination port range for traffic matching in the QoS rule. Valid values: 0 to 65535. Set the value to -1 if no matching is required. Currently, only a single port number can be specified. The start and end port numbers must be the same. The destination port range is fixed for each protocol type. Valid values:

ALL: -1/-1. Not editable.

ICMP(IPv4): -1/-1. Not editable.

ICMPv6(IPv6): -1/-1. Not editable.

TCP: -1/-1. Editable.

UDP: -1/-1. Editable.

GRE: -1/-1. Not editable.

SSH: 22/22. Not editable.

Telnet: 23/23. Not editable.

HTTP: 80/80. Not editable.

HTTPS: 443/443. Not editable.

MS SQL: 1443/1443. Not editable.

Oracle: 1521/1521. Not editable.

MySql: 3306/3306. Not editable.

RDP: 3389/3389. Not editable.

PostgreSQL: 5432/5432. Not editable.

Redis: 6379/6379. Not editable
parameters.help_zh:
QoS规则流量匹配目的端口号范围。取值范围：0~65535，如果不匹配时取值为-1。当前只支持指定单个端口号，端口号的起始和终止需要相同。不同的协议类型，对应的目的端口号范围是固定的，取值如下：

ALL：-1/-1，不可编辑。

ICMP(IPv4)：-1/-1，不可编辑。

ICMPv6(IPv6)：-1/-1，不可编辑。

TCP：-1/-1，可编辑。

UDP：-1/-1，可编辑。

GRE：-1/-1，不可编辑。

SSH：22/22，不可编辑。

Telnet：23/23，不可编辑。

HTTP：80/80，不可编辑。

HTTPS：443/443，不可编辑。

MS SQL：1443/1443，不可编辑。

Oracle：1521/1521，不可编辑。

MySql：3306/3306，不可编辑。

RDP：3389/3389，不可编辑。

PostgreSQL：5432/5432，不可编辑。

Redis：6379/6379，不可编辑
parameters.name: dst_port_range

parameters.help_en: The DSCP value for traffic matching in the QoS rule. Valid values: 0 to 63. Set the value to -1 if no matching is required
parameters.help_zh: QoS规则匹配流量的DSCP值。取值范围：0~63，如果不匹配时取值为-1
parameters.name: match_dscp

parameters.help_en: The new DSCP value to remark on the traffic. Valid values: 0 to 63. Set the value to -1 if no remarking is required
parameters.help_zh: 修改流量中的DSCP值。取值范围：0~63，如果不修改时取值为-1
parameters.name: remarking_dscp

parameters.help_en:
The name of the QoS rule.

The name must be 0 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
QoS规则的名称。

长度为0～128个字符，不能以`http://` 或`https://`开头
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the QoS rule.

The description must be 0 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
QoS规则的描述信息。

长度为0～256个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: rule_description
